verified: The Decoder reports that Anthropic studied cross-session memory in Claude, that selective notes beat exhaustive archives in its tests, and that in a Pokémon Red test Claude Fable 5 got four times as far as Sonnet 3.7 using a handful of strategy files instead of more than 400; a "Dreaming" process for correcting faulty memories is also described.
unconfirmed: The primary research paper, the exact benchmark setup and scoring, how "Dreaming" is triggered or whether it is experimental or shipped, whether any of this is available to Claude API or app users, and the specific capabilities of a model named Claude Fable 5 — all of these rest on this single secondary report and are not independently verified here.

verified: 据 The Decoder 报道，Anthropic 研究了 Claude 的跨会话记忆机制，并在《宝可梦 红》测试中得出“选择性笔记优于穷举存档”的结果——较新的 Claude Fable 5 进展约为 Sonnet 3.7 的四倍。
unconfirmed: 四倍差距如何测量、各模型分别保留了多少文件、"Dreaming" 纠错流程的技术细节，以及这些方法是否会进入 Claude 产品；报道未提供论文链接、发布时间或任何独立复现结果。
